events.evidence: The Ponte Morandi viaduct collapses on the A10 motorway in Genoa, Italy.
Spain, Portugal, France, Germany and Luxembourg agree to take in 141 migrants
A man is arrested near the Palace of Westminster in London after a Ford Fiesta hit pedestrians, cyclists and a security barrier
